title: plugin.yaml
description: What one plugin watches, how often, and how to show it.

check.description: The kind of check. All but script are built in.

every.description: How often it runs. 1m unless you say.

timeout.description: How long it may take before it's stopped. 10s unless you say.

enabled.description: Whether it runs. The page can switch it too.

display.description: How the standard widget shows it. A list unless you say.

history.description: Keys of the items to keep 24 hours of: an item's number, or whether it was good.

watch.description: Keys of the items the snapshot watches from the start. Your own choice on the page wins.

tiles.description: Keys of the items the snapshot shows as tiles.

url.x-plain: should start with http:// or https://

match.description: program: a pattern found in its command line.

host.description: port: where to look. This computer unless you say.

path.description: file and folder: where it is. ~ is your home folder.

pattern.description: folder: which files count, like *.md. Every file unless you say.

script.x-plain: should be a file name, or one for each system, like `macos: macos.py`
script.description: script: the program to run, in the plugin's folder.

options.description: script: anything of its own. It's handed to the script as it is.

duration.x-plain: should be a number and s, m or h, like 30s, 5m or 1h
